description: This file manages polling intervals for nodes, logs, and debug information in a UI application. It provides functions to start and stop polling for each component, leveraging setInterval and clearInterval. The polling is conditional based on the current tab and interval setup.

methods.name: export function startNodesPolling(host: PollingHost) { startNodesPolling
methods.description: Initiates polling of nodes at a 5-second interval if not already polling.

methods.name: export function stopNodesPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopNodesPolling
methods.description: Stops polling of nodes by clearing the interval.

methods.name: export function startLogsPolling(host: PollingHost) { startLogsPolling
methods.description: Initiates polling of logs at a 2-second interval if not already polling, only if the active tab is 'logs'.

methods.name: export function stopLogsPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopLogsPolling
methods.description: Stops polling of logs by clearing the interval.

methods.name: export function startDebugPolling(host: PollingHost) { startDebugPolling
methods.description: Initiates polling of debug info at a 3-second interval if not already polling, only if the active tab is 'debug'.

methods.name: export function stopDebugPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopDebugPolling
methods.description: Stops polling of debug info by clearing the interval.
